Name: Haley changed into Robin Buckley from Stranger Things
Author: TheScarfedJirachi
Description:
[i]Hello![/i]
After a few days of working, I finally finished my retexture for Haley to robin! I know their personality doesn't really mesh but I am already married to Haley and didn't want to go through all the hassle of divorce, but that's beside the point. I am very new to retexturing so my apologies if it is not perfect!
If anyone knows how to change Haley's in-game name to Robin feel free to do so! (and please tell me how ahah :D)

[b]Downloading:[/b]

This is as simple as any other texture mod to download so don't fret!

Just go to your local stardew valley files in steam and then go to content/characters or content/portraits, depending on which you are doing, and replace the old .xnb files with the new Robin ones!
